orchestration.title: Orchestration
orchestration.description: Route chat tasks across your providers and models.

enable.label: Enable orchestration
enable.description: Let the orchestrator pick a model per step instead of running everything on one provider.

pool.title: Candidate pool
pool.description: Models the router can pick from, each pinned to a cost tier.

rules.title: Routing rules
rules.description: Ordered candidates per task type — the first available one wins.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: How a request is split into routed steps.

modeHints.auto: The planner model decomposes each request into typed steps.
modeHints.template: Requests run through a fixed pipeline you pick below.
modeHints.off: No planning — the whole request is routed as a single step.

planner.candidateDescription: Pool candidate used for plan generation and classification calls.

templates.title: Pipeline templates
templates.emptySteps: No steps yet — add one below.

execution.title: Execution limits
execution.description: Guardrails for parallel runs and fix loops.
execution.maxParallelDescription: How many subtasks may run at once (1–8).
execution.maxFixLoopsDescription: Retries when a step fails verification (0–5).
execution.onNoCandidateDescription: Ask before falling back, or skip the step.

save.emptyPool: Add at least one candidate before saving.

technicalInfo.default: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=untrusted. 신뢰할 수 있는 명령어: cat, cd, grep, head, ls, pwd, tail, git status/log/diff/show, find(-exec 제외) 등.

technicalInfo.bypassPermissions: sandboxMode=danger-full-access, approvalPolicy=never. 전체 시스템 접근, 신뢰할 수 있는 환경에서만 사용하세요.
technicalInfo.overrideNote: 채팅 인터페이스의 모드 버튼을 사용하여 세션별로 재정의할 수 있습니다.
